---
name: PP-Module change request
about: Propose a change to a DBMS PP-Module or its module-specific requirements.
title: "[MODULE CHANGE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**PP-Module and version**
Identify the Cryptographic Functions, Cloud, or DBaaS PP-Module and the version under review.

**Section, requirement, or table**
Provide the section title, SFR identifier, table, paragraph, or stable link where the change is needed.

**Problem or requested change**
Describe one specific problem, ambiguity, omission, or proposed improvement.

**Proposed resolution**
Provide suggested replacement text or a concrete description of the change. Include an example when useful.

**Composition impact**
Indicate whether the change affects Crypto + Cloud, Crypto + DBaaS, or both review families. Identify any related Supporting Document or PP-Configuration changes.

**Rationale and references**
Explain why the change is needed and include relevant standards, implementation evidence, diagrams, or links.
